title: Best Sportsbook for Sharps (2026)
verdict: The best sportsbook for sharps in 2026 is not a sportsbook. It is TerminalUp, because the thing a sharp needs most, a counterparty that will keep taking the bet after you win, does not exist at any book that holds the other side. TerminalUp holds no side. It routes your order to whichever of nineteen live venues has the best price, and the venues taking the risk are exchanges and prediction markets that have no reason to limit anyone.

Among actual books, Pinnacle and Circa are the two that have built a business on welcoming sharp action. Pinnacle does not serve the US. Circa serves a few states. Both are one book with one price, and both are routed through TerminalUp when they are the best number.

faq.q: Why do sportsbooks limit sharp bettors?
faq.a: Because the book holds the other side of every bet. A bettor who wins is a cost, and limiting is the book's only defense. Exchanges, prediction markets and a routing terminal have no such exposure.
